title: AlexNet wins ImageNet — deep learning era begins
description: Krizhevsky, Sutskever, and Hinton's deep convolutional network crushes the ImageNet competition by a 10-point margin, proving deep learning at scale. Triggers a decade-long AI research explosion.

title: Generative Adversarial Networks introduced by Goodfellow et al.
description: Ian Goodfellow proposes GANs — a framework where two neural networks compete: a generator creates fake data and a discriminator tries to distinguish it from real data. Becomes the foundation for synthetic image generation.

title: "Attention Is All You Need" — the Transformer architecture is published
description: Google Brain researchers introduce the Transformer, replacing recurrent networks with self-attention. Becomes the foundational architecture for every major language model that follows, from BERT to GPT to Claude.

title: OpenAI releases GPT-1 — first large-scale generative language model
description: OpenAI releases the first GPT (Generative Pre-trained Transformer), a 117M parameter model pre-trained on BooksCorpus. Demonstrates that unsupervised pre-training followed by fine-tuning achieves strong NLP results.

title: Google releases BERT — bidirectional language model sets new NLP benchmarks
description: Google releases BERT (Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers), pre-trained on Wikipedia and Books. Sets state-of-the-art on 11 NLP tasks. Becomes the dominant approach for NLP fine-tuning for years.

title: OpenAI unveils DALL-E — GPT-3 variant that generates images from text
description: OpenAI demonstrates DALL-E, a 12B parameter version of GPT-3 trained to generate images from text descriptions. Shows surprisingly creative and compositional outputs, marking the beginning of mainstream text-to-image AI.

title: GitHub Copilot launches in technical preview — AI pair programmer
description: GitHub and OpenAI launch Copilot, an AI coding assistant trained on public GitHub repositories. Powered by Codex (a GPT-3 descendant), it autocompletes functions and writes boilerplate from comments. First mass-market AI coding tool.

title: DeepMind releases AlphaFold 2 database — solves protein folding
description: DeepMind releases the AlphaFold Protein Structure Database with predicted structures for nearly all human proteins. Solves a 50-year grand challenge in biology. Over 1 million structures made freely available to researchers.

title: Midjourney enters open beta — AI art generation goes mainstream
description: Midjourney opens its Discord-based image generation tool to the public. Its distinctive artistic aesthetic and accessible interface make it one of the first AI tools to reach millions of non-technical users.

title: Stable Diffusion released openly — first open-source image generation model
description: Stability AI releases Stable Diffusion weights publicly, making high-quality image generation available for anyone to run locally. The open release triggers an explosion of derivative models, fine-tunes, and applications.

title: OpenAI releases Whisper — robust open-source speech recognition
description: OpenAI open-sources Whisper, a speech recognition model trained on 680,000 hours of audio. Achieves near-human transcription accuracy across dozens of languages and is released as freely usable open-source software.

title: ChatGPT launches — reaches 1 million users in 5 days
description: OpenAI launches ChatGPT as a free research preview. Built on GPT-3.5 with RLHF fine-tuning, it becomes the fastest-growing consumer application in history, reaching 100 million users in two months and triggering an industry-wide AI race.

title: Meta releases LLaMA — open foundation models from 7B to 65B parameters
description: Meta AI releases LLaMA (Large Language Model Meta AI) as a research artifact in sizes from 7B to 65B. Though access-gated, the weights leak within days, sparking an open-source LLM movement and countless fine-tuned derivatives.

title: Anthropic introduces Claude — constitutional AI assistant enters limited beta
description: Anthropic launches Claude, its first publicly available AI assistant trained with Constitutional AI (CAI). Positioned as a safer, more steerable alternative to ChatGPT. Released in limited beta via API and Slack integration.

title: Google opens Bard to public — powered by LaMDA, later PaLM 2
description: Google opens Bard, its conversational AI product, to the public in the US and UK following a stumbling demo in February. Initially powered by LaMDA and later upgraded to PaLM 2, it later becomes Gemini.

title: Mistral 7B released — outperforms Llama 2 13B on most benchmarks
description: Mistral AI releases Mistral 7B under Apache 2.0, a 7B model using grouped-query attention and sliding window attention. Despite its small size, it outperforms Llama 2 13B across most benchmarks and becomes a widely adopted open model.

title: DeepSeek releases its first open-source LLM
xAI releases Grok — real-time web-connected AI model with personality
OpenAI announces Sora — text-to-video model generates realistic 60-second clips
